answer: Each identity tends one ember on a knoll: lighting costs 70 POA, sunk, and it burns only on the identity's own verified jobs, one unit per job, one per hour. To answer, it shows its ember burning plus a sonnet — a 14-line receipt of its last fourteen jobs — signed by three neighbors who saw it lit. A copied ember fed by another's jobs goes cold, a mismatched sonnet is refused; the 70 POA is kept, the identity is barred 5 epochs, and a neighbor who signed a cold ember loses 30 POA standing. Ten clones need ten embers, ten knolls, ten sonnets — 700 POA — and the cost cannot be pooled or reused.
